entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.
entries.uk: А, точно, сьогодні ж День святого[n]Валентина. То ось чому сюди стільки[n]хлопців із дівчатами приходило.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.
entries.uk: А в тебе що, нічого цікавого[n]не намічається? Ти ж тут уже[n]майже рік.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...
entries.uk: От коли я був молодий, ого-го...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Good evening.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry to barge in like this...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He was quite considerate.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Welcome home, once again.
It's good to be back.
Have you been well?
Sorry to worry you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can imagine. But let me say one thing.
entries.uk: Можу уявити. Але дозволь сказати одне.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I could ask you the same. Glad to see[n]you're holding up, at least.
entries.uk: Можу спитати тебе про те саме. Рада[n]бачити, що ти принаймні тримаєшся.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...At least you're aware of it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was scared out of my mind, you know.[n]It was like you'd disappeared.
entries.uk: Я, знаєш, мало не збожеволіла від страху.[n]Ти наче крізь землю провалився.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And after that, I find out you turned[n]yourself in...?
entries.uk: А потім я дізнаюся, що ти[n]здався поліції?..

entries.en: Sorry.
It's my bad.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I forgive you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But you need to stop shouldering all[n]the burdens on your own, okay?
entries.uk: Але досить тягти весь тягар[n]самотужки, гаразд?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I want to support you, especially when[n]you're hurting. We can get through[n]our problems together.
entries.uk: Я хочу тебе підтримувати, особливо коли[n]тобі боляче. Ми можемо долати[n]труднощі разом.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry... I didn't mean to turn this into[n]a lecture.
entries.uk: Вибач... Я не хотіла перетворювати[n]це на лекцію.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not why I came here, anyway.
entries.uk: Та й прийшла я не для цього.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Chocolate. For you. I'm afraid it's not[n]homemade, but...
entries.uk: Шоколад. Для тебе. На жаль,[n]не домашній, але...

entries.en: This makes me happy.
I'll treat it with care.
I'm moved.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, I'm happy you're happy.
entries.uk: Що ж, я рада, що ти радий.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's nice, but you'll have to actually[n]eat it eventually, okay?
entries.uk: Це мило, але рано чи пізно його[n]доведеться таки з'їсти, гаразд?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Not that it isn't nice to hear, but that[n]might be a little melodramatic...
entries.uk: Чути це, звісно, приємно, але, мабуть,[n]це трохи мелодраматично...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We... came back, right? We're in the[n]real world this time?
entries.uk: Ми... повернулися, так? Цього разу[n]ми в реальному світі?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I've been studying hard. I'm looking[n]to apply to law school.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My dream of becoming a police[n]commissioner remains the same.
entries.uk: Моя мрія стати комісаром поліції[n]не змінилася.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, can I sit next to you...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're going back next month, right?
entries.uk: Ти ж наступного місяця їдеш додому, так?

entries.en: Will you miss me?
Come with me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Of course.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sure, just let me get my tickets.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I wish.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... our relationship can survive[n]a little distance, right?
entries.uk: Але... наші стосунки витримають[n]трохи відстані, правда?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Can I tell you something...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: When I was a phantom thief, I was[n]driven by one goal: to help those who[n]were unjustly suffering.
entries.uk: Коли я була Фантомною Злодійкою, мною[n]рухала одна мета: допомагати тим,[n]хто несправедливо страждає.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And that hasn't changed, of course.[n]That goal still keeps me going.
entries.uk: І це, звісно, не змінилося.[n]Ця мета досі веде мене вперед.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But now I have something else, too.
entries.uk: Але тепер у мене є ще дещо.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now, I have someone I want to be[n]happy. I want to stand beside them—[n]not as a phantom thief, but as myself.
entries.uk: Тепер є людина, якій я бажаю щастя.[n]Я хочу бути поруч із нею —[n]не як Фантомна Злодійка, а як я сама.

entries.en: Who?
Are you talking about...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Someone very special.
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Makoto...
